notes:
Movies now get the same page series and anime got last update.

The artwork, title, description and buttons stay fixed at the top, and underneath them two columns: your installed addons on the left, and the streams from the selected addon on the right. Only the columns scroll, so you never lose sight of what you are looking at. It is the same layout as seasons and episodes, with streams in place of episodes.

Stream cards are tidier. They now show exactly what the desktop app shows: the release line with its rating, then the addon's own details one per line. The duplicated row of tags above them is gone, so nothing is stated twice and the card reads as a clean list instead of a clump.

Every addon picker now starts with "All addons", which shows every source in one list. Addons are always listed in the same order as your Addons page.
